proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1577 indradhanuṣ explicitly means rainbow and gives Pali indradhanu and Prakrit iṁdadhaṇu/iṁdahaṇu. Selected indra/indar/indor/id ar-type plus dhanu(s) forms preserve the recognizable whole compound with regional vowel, rhotic and aspiration variation. These are links to the attested rainbow compound, with learned or regional Indo-Aryan transmission unresolved. Exact response: idardhanuś.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 548 explicitly gives Hindi dhanush both bow and rainbow; CDIAL 6726 dhanus gives Prakrit dhaṇu and regional bow forms. Survey dʰanus/dʰanūs/danu rainbow fits this family with final-sibilant retention/loss and aspiration/length notation preserved. The rainbow sense is primary-supported, not inferred merely from the English bow metaphor. Local Indo-Aryan transmission and learned influence remain unresolved. Exact response: danu.
